Step 1 of 5 · Your Angi account

Confirm your Angi account below. We will prepare the connection request for you, then guide you through the provider handoff.

Your business ID on the platform

On the Angi for Pros website, select your company name at the top right; the ID is beside your city and state. In the app, select the person icon, then Account credentials, and find your ID. It uses digits only (0 to 9), such as 12345678.

Account contact email
